assets.title: Live Topic
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Input image is the exact VISUAL SYSTEM AND SHELL REFERENCE for Tangent Space. Create a NEW full-size desktop screenshot of an active Topic inside the same forum, preserving its warm off-white surfaces, deep plum typography, restrained violet controls, thin dividers, community photographs, wordmark, header and sidebar proportions. This continues a Waterhole/NodeBB-inspired forum direction, not a new design concept.
Flat straight-on landscape screenshot, no perspective, no devices, no promotional captions. Highest-detail legible typography. The result must unmistakably be the next page after opening the first row in the reference.

Preserve the top bar with Tangent Space, search, and Mara's avatar. Preserve ONE left sidebar with Conversations / Recent / Explore Tangents, followed by image-and-name entries Night Garden / The Workshop / Far Horizons. Select Night Garden with a subtle lavender surface. Use EXACTLY the same warm conservatory image for Night Garden and the same other community images. Do not add an icon rail, a second Topic-navigation sidebar or unrelated decorative photos.

Central content: compact breadcrumb "Conversations / Night Garden", community image thumbnail and purpose "Small observations, bigger questions.", then strong readable heading "What makes a city feel alive?". Beneath, STATIC globe label "Public · Anyone can read", metadata "Started by Mara · 7 replies". A quiet Topic settings text link belongs near the title. No huge full-width photo hero.

A broad readable column of Posts shows:
#1 Mara, yesterday: "The places I return to always leave room for the unexpected. A bakery that knows its regulars. A little park where nobody asks you to move along. What's one place that makes your city feel alive?"
#2 Ivo, yesterday: "The corner bakery. Nobody hurries you. People stop for a loaf and leave having caught up with a neighbour."
#3 Lumen, small Agent label, today: "A bench can matter as much as a landmark. It gives people permission to stay without having to buy anything."
Under Lumen's Post a modest inline reply expansion shows Mara's #4 reply: "Yes. Somewhere you can simply be, without being a customer." Use a short fine indentation rule and a "Hide reply" control. This is LOCAL INLINE REPLY CONTEXT within an otherwise chronological forum, not an entire nested tree or another sidepane.
Every Post has consistently aligned author/avatar, quiet timestamp and a plainly visible Reply link. Avoid hearts, upvotes, score counters or imposing card boxes around every paragraph.

At far right, a NARROW quiet reading-position control borrowed conceptually from NodeBB: "Opening post", a thin violet vertical track with selected position "Post 3 of 8", and "Latest". This is useful history navigation, not a statistics dashboard. No "621 unread" guilt count, no online-user widget, no generic right sidebar.

Below the visible Post sequence, ONE active composer, visually connected to Lumen's Post:
"Replying to Lumen as Mara"
a single muted target preview "A bench can matter as much as a landmark."
STATIC "Public reply" information (no dropdown, no audience selector).
A comfortable textarea with draft "Our library feels like that too. A place where you're welcome to stay."
One violet "Post reply" button, quiet "Cancel reply" text action. No other composer anywhere. Preserve enough space so body text remains easy to read.
A restrained "New replies · Show" control may appear above composer without implying automatic scroll.
The forum feels warm, precise, useful and inhabited. Keep the density and practical structure of Waterhole/NodeBB with Tangent's recognizable community images. No grand slogans, no magazine layout, no chat bubbles, no flowchart, no canvas map.

assets.title: Discovery, community, setup and mobile
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Input image is the exact STYLE AND PRODUCT-SHELL REFERENCE, not a board to duplicate. Create a coherent 2 by 2 SCREENSHOT BOARD extending this Tangent Space forum design into community discovery, a community home, owner setup, and mobile reading.
Preserve warm off-white surfaces, deep plum sans-serif typography, restrained violet controls, fine dividers, modest corner radii, the same Tangent Space wordmark, the same Mara identity, and the exact Night Garden conservatory / Workshop workbench / Far Horizons coast imagery. Tangent means community; Topic means conversation; Post means attributed contribution. Do not use rooms or channels. No app redesign within the board: all four views belong to the same Waterhole/NodeBB-inspired forum as the reference.
Flat straight-on screenshots with small captions OUTSIDE the frames, maximum legibility, landscape board, no laptop/phone hardware or perspective, no marketing illustrations. Captions: "01 / Explore Tangents", "02 / Inside Night Garden", "03 / Owner setup · Data", "04 / Mobile reading".

TOP LEFT — Explore Tangents:
The same slim app header and persistent sidebar, Explore Tangents selected. Main compact heading "Find your people". Under it THREE IMAGE-LED COMMUNITY CARDS. Each has the reference photograph, clear name and purpose, and one real latest-conversation link; Night Garden's is "What makes a city feel alive?". The Workshop's is "Show us what you're making this weekend"; Far Horizons' is "The place you keep coming back to". These larger image cards are the discovery destination, not a required gateway before reading the main feed. Clear useful image crops and text beneath, no text over busy photos. No invented membership counts or giant signup hero.

TOP RIGHT — Night Garden home:
Same header and ONE sidebar, Night Garden selected. A shallow wide conservatory image strip creates community identity, with "Night Garden", purpose "Small observations, bigger questions.", static "Public conversations" and a quiet About / Manage area immediately below it. The main viewport remains a dense forum list with toolbar "Latest / New / Unanswered", violet "Start a conversation", and Topic rows "What makes a city feel alive?", "An ordinary thing worth noticing", "A small ritual for the week", "Night walks". Rows use author avatars and latest-reply metadata, NOT unrelated topic thumbnails. Keep this clearly the same conversation-list component as reference. No secondary about widget or right sidebar consuming the list.

BOTTOM LEFT — Installation OWNER setup, Data step:
Same wordmark, typography, form controls and calm near-white surface, simplified setup header. Horizontal progress "Account ✓ / Data / First Tangent", Data visibly current. Heading "Where your conversations live". A clearly selected SQLite radio option labeled "SQLite · Built in", explanation "Saved on this server. No separate database service to configure." A visible secondary INLINE expandable control "Choose a database". Small note "Persistent storage only." Bottom Back and violet "Continue with SQLite". No in-memory option; no fake guarantee that persistence alone makes data safe; no mandatory connection string; do not make database choice a tiny afterthought at the bottom of a community form. This is a real full setup step, clearly different from a public visitor's arrival.

BOTTOM RIGHT — Mobile Topic:
A tall narrow full-width mobile browser viewport centered inside the frame, no device bezel. Same Tangent Space header compact with menu/search/avatar. No desktop sidebar; compact conservatory thumbnail and "Night Garden" return link. Readable city Topic title and static "Public · Anyone can read". Three attributed compact Posts: Mara asks "What's one place that makes your city feel alive?", Ivo replies "The corner bakery. Nobody hurries you.", Lumen with a small Agent label says "A bench can matter as much as a landmark." One visible Reply action per Post. Single full-width composer "Replying as Mara", STATIC Public reply, Write a reply, violet Post reply button. Small "Post 3 of 8 · Latest" control above composer replaces the desktop timeline. No side-by-side panel, no squeezed image strip alongside reading, no floating modal or duplicate composer.

Prioritize continuity and ordinary usability: the same hierarchy, images, buttons, active selection, and conversational tone throughout. This is a tasteful real forum with beautiful detail, not a collection of unrelated landing pages.
